reuse.why: Hooks the new check into the existing refuseIfBankAccountLinked wrapper that every provider link handler already goes through, next to the existing link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once in link.ts and invoked once in the shared wrapper.

placement.why: The assertion sits in accounts/link.ts beside assertBankAccountNotLinked and is applied in the handler wrapper, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: One helper, one call in the wrapper, and tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clean and single-sourced; the wrapper name refuseIfBankAccountLinked no longer describes everything it refuses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six *-accounts-link handlers are registered through refuseIfBankAccountLinked, which now runs the closed check.

one_place.where: link.assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed, called only from refuseIfBankAccountLinked in accounts/app.ts, which wraps every provider link handler.
